page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfc8i.xlarge is a compute-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 4 dedicated vCPUs utilizing the x86_64 architecture, specifically driven by an Intel Xeon 6462C processor operating at a base clock speed of 3.3 GHz. The instance is configured with 8.0 GB of system memory, yielding a resource density of 2.0 GB of RAM per core.

This instance does not include any bundled local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached block storage. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 4 Gbps. The absence of integrated GPUs and local NVMe storage represents a clear architectural tradeoff, optimizing the server specifically for pure CPU-bound tasks rather than data-intensive storage operations or hardware-accelerated graphics processing.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated CPU allocation and 1:2 RAM-to-vCPU ratio make this instance a resource-dense option for workloads that require consistent CPU performance without the overhead of excess memory or local storage. Suitable workloads include web serving, batch processing, microservices, and lightweight computational tasks that benefit from high-frequency Intel Xeon processors.
